articles.title: To ensure permanent economic innovation, we must pass the Clarity Act now
articles.description: Congress needs 60 Senators willing to put innovation first and provide critical relief to the digital asset industry, argues Rep. Shri Thanedar (D-Mich.)

articles.title: Ether, solana, XRP likely to gain if Clarity Act progresses
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 15, 2026

articles.title: Why banks should stop worrying and learn to love the Clarity Act
articles.description: They could be the biggest winners from regulatory clarity, argues Alex Tapscott, CEO of CMCC Global Capital Markets.

articles.title: Velocity extends Series A to $48M at $200M valuation with backing from Visa, Circle, and Ripple
articles.description: The investment brings Velocity's Series A round to $48 million and values the London-based payments infrastructure firm at $200 million, CEO Eric Queathem said.

articles.title: Bitcoin gives back Monday's gain as Clarity Act odds fade on Polymarket
articles.description: Bitcoin fell 1.7% since midnight UTC to $76,862, unwinding a late Monday rally as Polymarket odds on the Clarity Act becoming law this year halved overnight.

articles.title: How a simple coding mistake let a hacker drain $7.8 million from a crypto wallet
articles.description: Security firms traced the $7.8 million loss to a helper contract the wallet owner had authorized, not to Safe itself.

articles.title: Nigel Farage-backed Stack BTC eyes $16 million gold dealer deal to fund bitcoin buy
articles.description: The proposed acquisition would use cash flow from precious metals sales to build bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: Hong Kong crypto exchange CoinEx to cease operations after 9 years in business
articles.description: Founder and CEO Haipo Yang cited mounting security and compliance risks and said he rejected a sale in favor of a “clean ending.”

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slides to $77,000 ahead of Senate vote on Clarity Act
articles.description: Senators take a procedural vote on the crypto market structure bill later Tuesday. Bitcoin has given back 3% since touching $79,530 overnight, with XRP and zcash the only majors gaining ground.

articles.title: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade
articles.description: Batch V1.1 would let users bundle up to eight linked transactions into one operation, with 27 of 35 trusted validators now backing the change.

articles.title: U.S. DOJ seeks $61 million in what it calls Iran's crypto-laundered black market oil sales
articles.description: Prosecutors have filed a civil forfeiture complaint against what they call Iran's illegal crypto proceeds that are used to fund its military.

articles.title: Solana transactions just got more than 3 times bigger, narrowing the gap with Ethereum
articles.description: Transaction V1 raises Solana’s limit to 4,096 bytes from 1,232, giving developers more room for multi-step trades, company-wallet approvals and privacy proofs.

articles.title: Democrats send counteroffer to Republicans over Clarity Act provisions
articles.description: Democratic Senators were said to be meeting late Monday to discuss the latest proposed draft text.

articles.title: U.S. House panel shares crypto tax bill ahead of hearing later this week
articles.description: The House Ways and Means Committee published a crypto tax bill addressing de minimis transactions, staking and other issues for which the industry's clamored for policies.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips to $77,800 as Senate Clarity Act vote nears and oil prices climb
articles.description: Bitcoin pulls back from $79,000 as the Senate prepares to vote on the Clarity Act and oil prices rise.

articles.title: Even if Clarity fails, Wall Street’s crypto push is unlikely to stop
articles.description: The Clarity Act could give banks, brokers and asset managers a clearer rulebook, but financial firms have already moved far enough into digital assets that failure may slow adoption rather than stop it.

articles.title: SEC's Atkins backs Clarity Act but says agency will keep pushing crypto rules without it
articles.description: The SEC chair said crypto issuance, transfer agent modernization and custody will form the backbone of the agency’s regulatory push.

articles.title: U.S. Senator Lummis says Democrats won't quit asking for more on crypto Clarity Act
articles.description: One of the top crypto market structure negotiators in Washington says she's run out of gas on new revisions for the bill she's worked on for more than five years.

articles.title: Robinhood plans share redemptions, voting rights for stock tokens, after criticism
articles.description: CEO Vlad Tenev said more shareholder features are coming as Robinhood’s offshore stock tokens draw scrutiny over ownership rights.

articles.title: Trump's $800 million stake into World Liberty Financial's token now has a timeline to becoming sellable
articles.description: Onchain records show that an $800 million crypto stake that matched Donald Trump's holding was moved into a vesting contract, locking any sales until 2028 after a mandatory 10% token burn.

articles.title: White House crypto adviser says Trump gave up 'historic' ethics powers in compromise
articles.description: President Donald Trump's digital assets adviser spoke at a Washington event the day after a new compromise language was released for the Clarity Act.

articles.title: Banks escalate stablecoin rewards fight as Senate prepares for a Clarity Act vote
articles.description: Eight banking groups on Monday said they want tighter limits on stablecoin rewards, keeping the ongoing banks-versus-crypto dispute alive in Congress.

articles.title: A bipartisan coalition of 17 state attorneys generals urge Senate to reject Clarity Act
articles.description: The state AGs said they were concerned the crypto legislation might restrict their ability to bring securities and commodities cases tied to online scams.

articles.title: Clarity Act odds surge on prediction markets, but crypto bill still faces long road
articles.description: Kalshi and Polymarket bettors sharply raised the chances of U.S. crypto market structure legislation advancing, with Tuesday's Senate vote the next test.

articles.title: Consensus heads to Hong Kong for third year with expanded focus on AI
articles.description: Consensus Hong Kong will focus on institutional adoption of digital assets and the growing role of artificial intelligence in the future of money.
